If the license is negative, unlock J2534 and send the license result. Otherwise require at least one current SessionId row.
For the first client, invoke ExecuteAdaptation with SC000001, SessionId, and request JSON. Discard its direct return value.
Parse resultInfo from the response JSON. Only a non-null resultInfo with Result=0 sets matching session DiagnosisStarted=true and all shared DiagnosisStarted=true.
A null resultInfo or nonzero Result unlocks J2534. Forward nonempty response JSON unchanged.
An empty response uses BaseErrorResponseMessage with the parsed result object. A missing parsed result uses the Common helper fallback.
When shared diagnosis already exists, attach matching SessionId rows only if the first row has DiagnosisStarted=false.
Attachment does not invoke native start or update the license. Duplicate membership and missing SessionId return code 0xFFFF, error 9.
Ordinary end requires shared diagnosis. It rejects caller ActiveTestStarted or DataMonitorStarted with code 0xFFFF, error 11.
Find diagnosis members with a different SessionId. If any exist, clear matching SessionId membership and synthesize success.
If no other member exists, call ExecuteEndDiagAdaptation.
ExecuteEndDiagAdaptation invokes the adapter and discards its direct return. After it returns, clear all shared diagnosis flags.
Then clear all live diagnosis member flags, replace shared VehicleInformation, unlock J2534, clear polling, clear permission, and clear GeneralCommStarted.
Clear report VehicleInformation under its lock. Read DistributorDepending.CommunicationLogDelete.
Keep communication logs only when that nullable setting equals 0. Otherwise clear logs. A settings error also clears logs.
Set communication log mode to 1 and return the adapter response JSON.
Internal end constructs SC000002 and calls ExecuteEndDiagAdaptation without the ordinary caller monitor guards or membership check.
semantics.title: Diagnosis membership and first/last client transitions

errors: Preserve the different -3 mappings. Do not replace them with one shared policy.
ExecuteStartDiagnosis can continue for a positive nonzero snapshot despite UpdateLicenseState returning an error.
steps: UpdateLicenseState invokes LNXX0001 with empty SessionId and message. It defaults the snapshot to -1.
Deserialize a nonempty InternalGetLicenseStatusResponse. A parse exception keeps -1.
Write the snapshot to every shared LicenseStatus.
Snapshot 0 returns success. Snapshot -1 returns code 0x4006. Snapshots -2 and -3 return code 0x4004.
Every other snapshot returns code 0x4005. These UpdateLicenseState results use error 10.
A negative snapshot clears polling. A positive nonzero snapshot returns an error, but start tests the stored sign rather than this result.
CheckDiagnosisApiAvailable rejects absent shared diagnosis with code 0x3105, error 13.
Its negative-license map differs: -2 gives 0x4004. All other negative values, including -3, give 0x4006.
A nonnegative snapshot passes this license gate.
semantics.title: License snapshot and admission errors

errors: The DV, UG, and XX tests here use Contains, not prefix equality.
There is no analogous any-ActiveTestStarted gate in this method.
Admission reads shared diagnosis, not caller diagnosis membership.
The monitor whitelist uses exact case-sensitive API IDs.

ordered_gates.admit: exact before-confirmation list OR prefix before-confirmation list OR exact only-before-confirmation list OR (ImgOpeDdrPermission AND exact permission list)

ordered_gates.reject: apiId absent from AVAILABLE_DATA_MONITORING exact list

semantics.result: Each failure returns result=-1, type=AppCtrl, error=13. Every passed gate returns result=0, code=0, error=0.
semantics.title: Confirmation, general communication, and monitor admission

errors: Internal active-test stop serialization failure returns code 0xFFFF, error 14.
Internal monitor stop first serialization failure returns local success despite its logged error. Other local failures use code 0xFFFF, error 15.
Missing resultInfo is an error in internal stop paths. It is not an error in the outer response-forwarding path.
A successful adapter response can precede a failed PF start-state parse. The PF then reports success without recording monitor ownership.
steps: ExecuteDiagnosisApiCall checks admission, then invokes AdaptationIFExecuteAndResponse without a status update.
The checked variant checks admission, invokes ExecuteAdaptation, and parses resultInfo.
For null resultInfo or Result!=0, forward the response without a status update.
For Result=0, check type 1 means data-monitor start, 2 means monitor stop, 3 means active-test start, and 4 means active-test stop.
Start helpers deserialize OnlyEcuIdRequestMessage from the original request. They set matching SessionId rows Started=true and EcuId=requestEcuId.
Start-helper deserialization failure returns code 0xFFFF, error 12 without a status update. The caller discards that helper result when it sends the original response.
Stop helpers find every flagged live row, then clear Started and EcuId on all those rows. They do not filter by SessionId or ECU ID.
Internal active-test stop constructs DV000025 for the detached request row ActiveTestEcuId. It clears all active-test rows only after a parsed Result=0.
Internal monitor stop constructs DV000017 for DataMonitorEcuId. Only parsed Result=0 proceeds to DV000032 with the same ECU and sessionDiagMode=0.
Internal monitor stop returns the parsed second result. It contains no DataMonitorStarted or DataMonitorEcuId reset.
semantics.title: Monitor and active-test status commit rules

errors: A standalone active test without any data-monitor row does not enter the active-test stop branch.
Serialization failures can return early with code 0xFFFF, error 57. Adapter execution exceptions are not caught by those serialization catches.
Returned native stop/end errors do not prevent the final success response.
Broadcast serialization failure creates a worst response and multicasts it with send type 4.
steps: Reject absent shared diagnosis with code 0xFFFF, error 57.
Find all data-monitor rows. Only when that set is nonempty, also search active-test rows.
If active-test rows exist in that branch, send DV000025 for their first ECU and SessionId. Then clear those flags, including returned errors.
Send DV000017 for the first monitor ECU and SessionId. Save its ECU ID, then clear all found monitor flags, including returned errors.
Send DV000032 for the saved monitor ECU with sessionDiagMode=0. A returned error logs and sleeps 5000 milliseconds before continuation.
Construct SC000002 and invoke ExecuteEndDiagAdaptation with the caller GuiInformation. Parse and log its returned error, if any.
Replace the operation result with success. Send a success response to the forced-end caller.
Construct CN000008 with id=3 and caller Name. Send it to other eligible connections through send type 2.
semantics.title: Forced teardown order and errors

errors: The DV000089 join compares vehicle ID. It does not require native resultInfo.Result=0 before the comparison.
Request parse failures, adapter-call exceptions, cache-response parse failures, and report serialization failures have separate catches.
Shared confirmation is not keyed by caller SessionId. All clients observe the selection from entry zero.
The report-serialization catch computes a local error but sends the earlier result variable. Preserve this returned-result defect.
steps: SC000003 first checks diagnosis admission. Deserialize NotifyVehicleConfirmationRequestMessage and require VehicleId!=0.
Bad request serialization shape returns code 0x1FFF, error 55.
Construct DV000089, execute it, and deserialize GetVehicleCacheResponseMessage.
Require a present response apiArgs.VehicleId equal to requested VehicleId. A mismatch returns code 0x3104, error 55.
On equality, assign the request apiArgs reference to every shared VehicleInformation.
Serialize those apiArgs and update error-report VehicleInformation under its lock. A later failure does not restore shared selection.
IF000004 reads shared entry zero. VehicleId=0 produces a success envelope without confirmation apiArgs.
Otherwise copy the request common/free, shared confirmation apiArgs, and success result into GetVehicleConfirmationResponseMessage.
SC000012 checks admission, then sets every shared ImgOpeDdrPermission=true and sends success.
semantics.title: Vehicle selection publication

detach_sequence: Find SessionId rows. Missing rows return code 0xFFFF, error 17.
Append TGXX0001 for the first detached row. Preserve its GuiInformation reference in all generated cleanup tasks.
If that row owns a monitor, find any active-test rows. If found, copy their first ECU to the detached row and append DVXX0002.
Then append DVXX0001. Otherwise append DVXX0002 only if the detached row itself owns an active test.
If exactly one locked row has the detached Name, append CNXX0001.
If the detached row is a diagnosis member and the live member count equals one, append SCXX0005 when general communication is active.
In that last-member branch, append DVXX0004.
If exactly one named non-license row exists and it has the detached SessionId, append SCXX0002, then LNXX0003.
In that branch, append SCXX0004 only when DialogUtilityStarted=false and shared diagnosis=true.
Then append IFXX0001, auto-save the error report, and disable its hotkey.
Remove all live rows with the SessionId. Return success before queued cleanup runs.
errors: The live row disappears before cleanup. XX messages bypass the base live-session filter and use the retained row object.
The disconnection cleanup can be delayed by the vehicle FIFO. A new connection does not wait for it.
PF does not automatically recreate diagnosis on Connect. A new SessionId must run HELLO and explicitly attach.
The exact standalone-disconnect retention and native end-instance behavior belongs to the diagnostic adaptation owner.
semantics.title: WebSocket detach and transport disconnect
transport_sequence: Internal DVXX0004 returns success without disconnect when GeneralCommStarted=true.
Otherwise construct request JSON whose common.apiId is DV000035. Pass the original ApiTaskMessage.ApiId as the ExecuteAdaptation selector.
Parse resultInfo. Missing resultInfo logs but returns local success.
A broad execution/serialization exception returns code 0xFFFF, error 50.
Its finally always calls J2534ExclusiveUnlock and clears polling once the execution try begins.
Public DV000035 checks admission, then invokes and sends the adapter response.
After that call returns, public disconnect unlocks J2534 and clears polling, including returned adapter errors.
A public adaptation/send exception bypasses those resets because no finally surrounds them.

errors: The worker uses wall-clock DateTime.Now, not a monotonic clock. Polling runs only when its message wait times out.
Continuous DV work defers polling because each such request updates the last communication time.
During end confirmation, a released barrier plus EndFlag clears polling and resumes the cancellation loop.
Checker request/response/broadcast serialization failures return code 0xFFFF, error 54. Adapter exceptions are outside those parse catches.
steps: SC000008 checks diagnosis admission and rejects an already positive PollingInterval with code 0xFFFF, error 52.
Deserialize StartBatteryVoltagePollingRequestMessage. Require apiArgs, PollingInterval in [500,60000], and ThresholdVoltage in [1000,30000].
Parse or range failure returns code 0x1FFF, error 52. Store the apiArgs reference in shared entry zero and set LastVehicleCommunicationTime=DateTime.Now.
The vehicle worker waits indefinitely when interval<=0. Otherwise wait max(0, interval-int32((DateTime.Now-last).TotalMilliseconds)).
A signaled event drains the queue. After an executed API whose first two characters equal DV, refresh LastVehicleCommunicationTime.
A polling wait timeout invokes ExecuteVehicleDisconnectCheck and refreshes LastVehicleCommunicationTime.
SC000009 checks admission before Clear. Internal SCXX0002 clears without admission and sends no response.
The checker constructs DV000081 with a fresh empty GuiInformation. An admission failure returns local success without an adapter call.
Otherwise call the adapter, deserialize GetVBatteryValueResponseMessage, and compare vBatteryValue with the threshold.
An error result or voltage below threshold sends CN000008 with id=4 and empty Name to all eligible clients.
A success result with voltage at least the threshold sends no notification. The checker does not disconnect transport or end diagnosis.
semantics.title: Idle battery polling and disconnect notification

errors: UG operations require this state. Ordinary DV operations are rejected while it is true, except IDs containing XX.
Transport disconnect returns early while this state is true. Last-member WebSocket detach therefore queues internal general end before internal disconnect.
steps: SC000013 checks diagnosis admission, invokes the adapter, and parses resultInfo.
Only present Result=0 sets all shared GeneralCommStarted=true. Forward the original response regardless of state commit.
SC000014 checks admission, invokes and sends the response, then clears every GeneralCommStarted flag after the helper returns.
A returned adapter error still clears the flag. A thrown helper bypasses the reset.
Internal SCXX0005 constructs SC000014 and invokes the adapter without admission.
Internal end converts missing or nonzero resultInfo into code 0xFFFF, error 94. It clears all flags even for these returned errors.
A caught internal execution exception returns code 0xFFFF, error 94 before the flag reset.
semantics.title: General communication state lifetime

errors: Unchecked send success is not proof of network delivery or ECU success.
No send wait in this family has a timeout.
Send type 3 retains its observed implementation mismatch. Do not implement its enum name instead of its switch branch.
rules: GetResultInfoData(result,code,type,error) writes Result and Code as int32. It writes ErrorCode=error.ToString() and DetailCode=SC+type+error.ToString().
MakeResponseMessage copies current request common and free to the supplied response object, or a new BaseResponseMessage.
Only code=0 and error=0 produce Result=0. Any other pair produces Result=-1.
MakeResponseMessage catches JSON serialization failure and returns empty string. It does not catch earlier null request access.
SendAck serializes ackMessage.apiId, ackMessage.cancelId, and free. It ignores the task returned by SendAsync.
SendResponseMessage and SendResultInfoResponseMessage also ignore SendAsync completion. Empty response returns a local error instead.
AdaptationIFExecuteAndResponse discards ExecuteAdaptation return value. It forwards the out response string through send type 0.
BaseErrorResponseMessage uses GetErrorResponseMessage and ignores SendAsync completion. Its success result means local response construction, not target API success.
GetErrorResponseMessage preserves request common/free when parsing succeeds. Missing/null result uses Common error 1. Parse failure uses a worst response.
GetWorstResponseMessage manually formats resultInfo.result, code, and detailCode as JSON strings. It omits common and free.
SendResponseMessageFromExecuteTask rejects only string equal to empty. Send type 1 performs checked unicast.
Send type 2 multicasts to others without waiting. Send type 4 multicasts to all without waiting.
Send types 0 and 3, and unknown values, perform unicast without waiting. Type 3 is named MulticastOthersCheck but follows this default.
Multicast eligibility requires MaxSameNameConnectionNum>0 and Name!=GTSPlusLicense.
The others filter excludes only a row with both matching SessionId and matching Ssl.
Checked unicast blocks on task.Result, then tests WSMResultEntity.Result. False returns code 0xFFFF, error 47.
Direct multicast calls with check=true use Task.WhenAll.Wait and inspect every task result. Any false or caught wait failure returns code 0xFFFF, error 48.
The initial send/enumeration stage is outside that multicast wait catch. Each enumerator is disposed through finally.
GetRequestMessageParseObject catches deserialization exceptions and returns null.
semantics.title: Response envelopes and send completion semantics

errors: These task waits have no timeout. Cancel alone does not signal the worker message events.
A worker already terminated by exception can miss FinalizeFunction. The later platform wait does not call it again.
The alive callback tests recorded task status and returns PF000005 on mismatch. It does not restart tasks.
steps: InitializePlatform creates the manager and five workers, initializes adapters, starts the main sequence, and starts configured timers.
The settings lookup immediately replaces StartMainSequence result. A successful settings lookup can mask a failed main-sequence start.
End confirmation resets seven confirmation events and sets EndCheckFlag on the main sequence and workers.
CheckEditFile selects the confirmation result. The confirmation method does not itself wait for all barriers.
Approved execution clears queues 1..6. Non-shutdown execution broadcasts CN000008/id=10 with checked multicast.
Set main and worker EndFlag. Both approval and veto reset EndCheckFlag and signal confirmation events.
FinalizePlatform cancels the shared token, stops WebSocket handling, then waits for the main task.
Signal each worker message event and wait for its task in worker-array order. Vehicle normal loop exit invokes its mutex finalizer.
Finalize adapters, wait for the settings receiver inner task, then stop the sleep timer.
The outer catch logs and skips any remaining cleanup after a thrown operation.
semantics.title: Platform shutdown and worker retirement

rules: EX000001 finds the first y, M, and d in CurrentCulture ShortDatePattern. Missing any marker returns code 0xFFFF, error 45.
Date ordering maps yMd=1, ydM=2, Myd=3, Mdy=4, dyM=5, dMy=6.
IF000009 calls GetGuid. Empty SoftwareId or LogicVersion returns code 0xFFFF, error 58. Otherwise return both strings.
ResetPFConfig obtains the settings folder, then copies install/Env/DefaultPF.cfg over current PF.cfg if the default exists.
A missing default is success. A folder failure or caught copy exception returns code 0x1FFF, error 65.
PutLogGuiStatus serializes shared and per-session state through callbacks. It writes one GUI Status action log at the requested level.
DV000104 checks diagnosis admission and invokes the adapter. Parse its GetVimVersionResponseMessage only for report enrichment.
On response parse failure or PC-settings failure, forward the original adapter response despite a local error.
On Result=0, read PC VIM Name and HKLM registry Vendor. Copy Firmware, DLL, and API versions into report VimInformation.
Dispose registry and enumerator handles. Update report GtsPlusInformation under its lock. Forward the original response.
semantics.title: Local support functions

steps: Acquire required J2534 ownership before every selector branch.
Use exact-ID string comparisons before the generic family path. The exact map is stored separately in vehicle_selector.
The generic UG path checks diagnosis admission and invokes the adapter without writing VehicleConnectionCancelId.
The generic non-UG path first writes message.CancelId to every shared VehicleConnectionCancelId.
Then invoke ExecuteDiagnosisApiCall. After it returns, clear every shared VehicleConnectionCancelId to zero.
That clear has no finally. A thrown admission or adaptation call can leave the active cancellation ID set.
DV000061 and DV000080 check admission, then set shared entry zero DialogUtilityStarted=true.
Run UtilitySequencer.ExecuteUtility synchronously, then clear DialogUtilityStarted after it returns.
If no named non-license connection remains, enqueue SCXX0004 on queue 1. Do not send the utility response in that branch.
Otherwise send the utility response to the original SessionId. A thrown sequencer call can leave DialogUtilityStarted=true.
semantics.title: Vehicle selector, active cancellation slot, and utility retirement

steps: MessageExecuteTask selects CN000007 for GUI relay. It selects CN000005, CN000006, CNXX0001, UPXX0002, and UPXX0003 for broadcast.
The broadcast uses CN000008 and the retained request row Name.
Broadcast id is 1 for lock, 2 for unlock or final locked-row detach, 6 for UPXX0002, and 7 for UPXX0003.
The worker sends to other eligible clients with send type 2. Serialization/send exceptions return code 0xFFFF, error 8.
CNXX0001 does not clear another row flag. Final row removal already removes that group lock when no same-Name owner remains.
GUI relay deserializes ScreenRelayRequestMessage and requires a nonempty target Name. Parse/name errors use code 0x1FFF, error 7.
Construct guiRelayMsg with the original apiId and data. Find exact target-Name rows except the sender SessionId and GTSPlusLicense.
Send each relay with checked unicast. Missing recipients or any returned Result=-1 keep code 0xFFFF, error 7.
A nonempty recipient set with no returned Result=-1 selects success. Reply to the sender with original common/free.
Relay response serialization errors return a local error. They do not send a second fallback response.
semantics.title: Exclusion broadcasts and GUI relay

rules: Each policy-array getter creates a fresh string array in the displayed order.
Array.IndexOf>=0 means exact membership. The IL often expresses this as 0<=IndexOf.
Do not replace Contains tests in other methods with these prefix or exact-ID tests.
The type initializer assigns GTSPlusInfo.ini, AppInfo, SessionEndCheckTimeout, WaitConnectTime, DefaultPF.cfg, and FunctionDisable=0.
semantics.title: Exact policy arrays and constants

defects: File-edit wrappers do not use try/finally around the operation. An escaping exception omits EndFileEdit.
The manager does not compare a_apiId with request.common.apiId. Managed routing and native routing can differ.
This method does not impose native-operation mutual exclusion.
Neither FinalizeAdaptation nor UnloadDiagAdaptation invokes native destroy.
Neither method zeroes DiagAdaptationInstance. Finalize can leave a stale instance pointer.
sequence: InitializeAdaptation returns GetResultInfoData(0,0,DiagManager,0). It does not load or create native state.
FinalizeAdaptation calls UnloadDiagAdaptation only when module handle is nonzero. It discards the unload result and returns outer success.
Unload rejects a zero handle with (-1,65535,DiagManager,14).
Unload invokes FreeLibrary, discards its boolean, zeroes the module handle, and nulls create/destroy/execute/cancel/freememory delegates.

exceptions: The catch covers export/delegate resolution only. Settings, native challenge invocation, copy, AES key decoding/encryption, and authentication invocation exceptions are not translated here.
An exception after loading but outside the delegate-resolution catch can leave the library loaded.
ownership: The manager copies the challenge pointer but does not call freememory for it. Native challenge-buffer lifetime remains in the native export contract.
sequence: Reject an already nonzero module handle with (-1,65535,DiagManager,13).
Resolve cassette root from oemDecisionInfo. Read encrypted install settings via DecryptFileCS(out text,1). Nonzero decoder status returns load error.
Discard text through the first LF. Read configured DiagAdaptation path. Use cassette/bin/DiagAdaptation.dll when the configured path is empty.
LoadLibraryEx(path,0,LOAD_WITH_ALTERED_SEARCH_PATH). Zero handle returns load error.
Resolve CreateChallengeCode, CheckAuthenticationCode, create, destroy, execute, cancel, freememory and construct delegates. Delegate-resolution exception logs, unloads, and returns load error.
Require both authentication delegates. Otherwise unload and return load error.
Invoke CreateChallengeCode(out pointer,out int32 size). False unloads and returns load error. Copy size bytes from the pointer.
Create AesCng. Decode the configured authentication key for DiagAdaptation. Set Key. Encrypt copied challenge via CreateEncryptor().TransformFinalBlock().
Concatenate the generated IV followed by ciphertext. Invoke CheckAuthenticationCode(bytes,length). False unloads and returns load error.
Dispose AesCng in finally. Return (0,0,DiagManager,0) after authentication success.

defects: Failure cleanup discards destroy failure and clears the managed instance anyway.
Serialization exceptions and nullable-region Value exceptions are not caught in this method. They can leave a loaded library.
Manager information is written even after native-start failure and cleanup. It is not proof of an open native session.

inputs.request.apiArgs.oemDecisionInfo: int32, defaults0 when apiArgs is null

apiArgs.appPath: cassette root with a trailing backslash

sequence: Set response to empty string. Reject nonzero instance without mutating ownership. Embed (-1,65535,DiagManager,3), return outer success.
Read setting IDs3 and4. Either nonzero status embeds the same start error and returns outer success.
Deserialize StartDiagnosisRequestMessage. Failure embeds (-1,8191,DiagManager,3), returns outer success.
LoadDiagAdaptation(oemDecisionInfo). Nonzero result is embedded and outer success returned.
Construct DNTStartDiagnosisRequestMessage from common/free and rewritten appPath/regionId/languageCode. Serialize with JsonConvert. Empty output unloads and embeds start error.
Invoke create and store returned native pointer. Zero pointer unloads and embeds start error.
Invoke DiagFunction(a_apiId, rewritten request, out response). Parse response.resultInfo.
If parsed result is absent OR result!=0: invoke destroy, discard its boolean, zero managed instance, log, and unload.
Regardless of native-start response success or failure, store region and language under the manager information lock. Return the DiagFunction outer result.

defects: A failed end leaves native ownership intact while manager metadata is already cleared.
End only blocks destroy for result==-1. Start failure tests result!=0. These predicates differ.
sequence: Set response empty. Clear nullable region and language under the manager information lock before checking native ownership.
Missing destroy delegate embeds (-1,65535,DiagManager,4) and returns outer success.
Invoke DiagFunction. Discard its outer result. Parse response.resultInfo.
Missing parsed result returns outer success without destroy or unload.
Exactly result==-1 logs and returns outer success without destroy or unload.
Any other result, including1 cancellation, proceeds to destroy(instance).
False destroy embeds end error and retains instance/module/delegates.
True destroy zeroes instance and calls UnloadDiagAdaptation. Return outer success.

defects: Response scan has no length bound.
No try/finally protects native response ownership. Copy/decoding exceptions omit freememory.
Native execute=false with nonzero response still follows decode/release.
Native freememory failure is invisible in outer result.
sequence: Clear response. Require both execute AND cancel delegates, even for an ordinary execution. Missing either embeds (-1,65535,DiagManager,5), returns outer success.
Unless a_apiId==SC000001, require nonzero managed instance. Missing instance embeds the same execution error and returns outer success.
When a_apiId==SC000005, invoke cancel(instance), not execute. True synthesizes success response. False embeds (-1,16386,DiagManager,5). Return outer success in both cases.
Otherwise initialize response pointer to zero. Invoke execute(instance,UTF8 request,out pointer). Discard the native boolean.
Zero pointer embeds execution error and returns outer success. Nonzero pointer is scanned byte-by-byte until NUL.
Allocate exactly the byte length, Marshal.Copy, and decode with Encoding.UTF8.GetString. Zero pointer passed to the converter returns empty string.
Call freememory(instance,ref pointer). Discard its boolean. Return outer success.
Read nullable regionId and languageCode under the manager information lock.
Serialize InternalGetStartDiagnosisInformationResponse.
Catch serialization exception, log (-1,0,DiagManager,6), leave output empty, and still return outer success.
semantics.state_scope: Per-manager information lock protects only metadata reads/writes. It is not a native execution lock.

helpers.CalculateImgOpeDdrHash: UTF8 encode JSON, pass byte[]+length to GTSPlusFileCryptographic CalculateImgOpeDdrHash. Native status0: decode returned UTF16 pointer and invoke that DLL FreeMemory. Nonzero: log and return(-1,0xFFFF,DiagManager,11).
helpers.GetSpecificFolder: Read settingID1. Failure logs(-1,0xFFFF,DiagManager,8) and returns empty. Find first SpecificFolder with nullable No present and equal folderNo. Pass its Path, or null when absent, to Environment.ExpandEnvironmentVariables. Null can throw rather than return empty.

MakeImgOpeDdrCsvData.defect: This is global text replacement, not a JSON parser or standards-compliant CSV escaping algorithm.
sequence: Copy original JSON to output. Globally remove all { and } characters.
Globally replace comma with comma+LF. Globally replace colon with comma. Globally replace literal backslash-n with literal backslash-n followed by quote,comma,quote.
Append comma+LF. Scan physical LF boundaries while counting lines starting1.
Except line numbers1,2,19,20, inspect two characters at LF_index-3. If they are not two quotes, insert literal backslash-n at LF_index-2. Advance past inserted characters and LF.
An exception in IndexOf scanning exits the scan. Substring/Insert exceptions outside that catch can escape.
Remove final two characters. Hash ORIGINAL JSON, not the transformed CSV.
On hash success append LF+hash. On hash failure clear CSV and return helper error.

MakeImgOpeDdrJsonData.note: Every log uses ReadLogFile. Missing log becomes empty text, not a failed aggregate operation. Exact serialized member names are in manager metadata/IL evidence.

helpers.ReadLogFile: Read all UTF8 text from Path.Combine(folder,file). Dispose reader in finally. Any exception logs(-1,0x2FFF,DiagManager,9) and returns empty string.

ordered_effects: Deserialize or embed(-1,0x1FFF,DiagManager,7).
GetSpecificFolder(folderNo). Empty result embeds(-1,0xFFFF,DiagManager,7).
Use local DateTime.Now. Replace VIN characters matching [^A-Za-z0-9-]+ with underscore. Filename is sanitizedVIN_yyyyMMddHHmmss.vdas.
If destination exists, embed(-1,0x2FFF,DiagManager,7).
Assemble IMG/OPE/DDR JSON from install/LOGS/ECUData files. Serialize it and replace doubled literal backslash-n with single literal backslash-n. Serialization catch embeds(-1,0xFFFF,DiagManager,7).
Ensure ECUData directory, write json.log with UTF8Encoding(false). File catch embeds(-1,0x2FFF,DiagManager,7).
Ensure destination directory. Compress json.log to VDAS via ZipFile.CompressFileToFile(...,6). Compression catch embeds(-1,0x2FFF,DiagManager,7).
Return filename response via MakeResponseMessage. Intermediate json.log is not deleted.
Deserialize or embed(-1,0x1FFF,DiagManager,10). Resolve specific folder. Empty folder embeds(-1,0xFFFF,DiagManager,10).
CSV name is Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(fileName)+.csv. If overwrite!=1 and CSV exists, embed(-1,0x2FFF,DiagManager,10).
Decompress folder/fileName into install/LOGS/ECUData. Decompression catch embeds(-1,0x2FFF,DiagManager,10).
Read ECUData/json.log using UTF8Encoding(false). Read catch embeds(-1,0x2FFF,DiagManager,10).
Call MakeImgOpeDdrCsvData. Nonzero helper result becomes embedded response error.
Write destination CSV using UTF8Encoding(false), with no BOM. Write catch embeds(-1,0x2FFF,DiagManager,10).
Return MakeResponseMessage success. Decompressed intermediate is not deleted.
Deserialize failure calls MakeResponseMessage(-1,0x1FFF,DiagManager,12).
Build BDCorrectedResultData. CommonInfo.LogType=input.logType. AppSpecificInfo.FileVer=1.01. Timestamp uses UTC yyyyMMddHHmmss. Other app fields are copied.
Read CommonApplicationData/GTSPlus/LOGS/BDCTmp/BDC_*.log in ascending path order. Use TextFieldParser with comma delimiter and quoted fields. Flatten every parsed field into a string list.
When at least one field exists, Data.Record is its string array. Serialize the BDC object. Preparation exception embeds(-1,0xFFFF,DiagManager,12).
Read settingID1 GTSPlusCommon. Nonzero setting result embeds(-1,0xFFFF,DiagManager,12). Expand DataCollectionSend path and append logType/sendFileName.

If CommonApplicationData/GTSPlus/ControllerTmp exists, recursively delete it. Recreate it. Write serialized data to ControllerTmp/sendFileName as UTF8. Ensure final output directory. Move temporary file to final path.
Move sequence exception embeds(-1,0x2FFF,DiagManager,12). Otherwise return MakeResponseMessage success.

semantics.abi: uint32 status; ECX adaptation instance; stack std::string apiId by value. Instance+0x94 stores numeric selector.
semantics.defect: Unknown prefix with six decimal digits returns parse success and a prefix0 selector. ExecuteApi later rejects selectors outside its table.
sequence: Null instance or API length0 returns C0270001.
Length other than8 returns C0270003.
Compare first2 bytes with strncmp against ordered rows DV=>1,SC=>2,UG=>3. Comparison is case-sensitive.
The prefix accumulator starts0. No-match does NOT return an error.
Positions2,3 must be decimal ASCII digits. Positions4..7 must be decimal ASCII digits. Any invalid digit returns C0270003.
